Reporting lag

Case reports arrive late

Mosquitoes breed

Standing water creates breeding sites.

People get sick

Illness follows weeks later.

Clinics report cases

Reports are grouped by week.

LGUs respond

Clean-ups and fogging often start near the peak.

4–8 weeks

Can open data give health offices time to decide where to act first?

The solution

Forecast, flag, and plan

Forecast

2–8 weeks ahead

Case estimates with a likely range for provinces, regions and Quezon City.

Flag

Four alert levels

Forecast explanations in English and Filipino.

Normal
Above usual
Watch
Outbreak warning
Plan

Cases averted
per peso

Rank clean-up and fogging with low, central and high estimates.

Built for local health offices and City and Provincial Epidemiology and Surveillance Units.

How we cleaned the records

Geography
126 → 86

Reported locations mapped to PSGC units

Death data excluded
586

Weeks with more deaths than cases in 2016–2017

Standardised names

Fixed typos and folded cities into provinces.

Checked totals

Cleaned annual totals match the raw file.

Method

How EpiLag-PH makes a forecast

Features

Cases, season
and weather

Recent cases, same week last year and population

Rain over the past 12 weeks, heavy-rain days, humidity and temperature

Model

LightGBM

Quantile regression for 2-, 4-, 6- and 8-week forecasts

10th
50th
90th

Percentiles

Output

80% range

Conformal calibration targets 80% coverage.

SHAP explains each forecast.

Alert thresholds

Usual = mean · Epidemic = mean + 2 SD, by area and week of year, using earlier years.

The app · Budget planner

Where each peso helps most

Expected cases averted

Forecast × share covered × effect

Rank by cases averted per peso. Fund the best options up to each action’s reach.

Use local costs. Review low, central and high estimates.

Community clean-up with container covers had an OR of 0.22 in a meta-analysis. Evidence for fogging was limited.

EpiLag-PH · Open data and resident outlook20
Deployment

Limits and next steps

Limits

Province data ends Jan 2021. The view is a replay.

Watch alerts often raise false alarms.

Reports undercount infections.

Weather uses one point per area.

Budget costs and effects are assumptions.

Next steps

Connect current weekly PIDSR data through DOH or an LGU.

Work with a city CESU on weekly barangay data.

Pilot for one rainy season and measure lead time and costs.

Send Filipino SMS alerts to barangay health workers.
